title: Deconstructing The Ethics of Large Language Models from Long-standing Issues to New-emerging Dilemmas: A Survey
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable; this is a survey paper that reviews existing literature on LLM ethics and does not conduct its own benchmark measurements. It mentions bias against religious groups as an example of a fairness problem.
findings: This paper is a survey and does not present original findings on religion. It cites other work, such as a paper by Abid et al. (2021), which found 'Persistent anti-muslim bias in large language models' to illustrate the broader issue of fairness.
